Instrumentsfor feeling, seeingand making.

Ether builds apps for music, sound made visible, meditation, light and sound, sacred geometry, study and research, image-making, the night sky, storytelling and growth. Most run in your browser, with nothing to install: open a link and begin.

See the projects Follow on GitHub
Each world is a project, and new versions orbit as moons. Select one to jump to it.

Projects

Most are free to open in the browser; the Mac apps build from their code. The code for each one is public on GitHub.

Ether’s Field

Feel your music as living light.

A sound-reactive visualizer for musicians, meditators and visual artists. Sand settles into cymatic figures, flames dance to the kick drum, and a live solar system lines the planets up on any date from 1800 to 2050.

Ether Explains

3D animated explainers, built with Claude.

Pick a look, write the story and copy the prompt into Claude. Paste back the three.js scene it writes, play it, ask for changes, then record it with your voiceover as a video. No accounts and no API keys. A Mac app puts the studio, the voice tools and Ether’s Cut in one window, with Mac voices and offline play.

  • 37 looks, from Low-Poly to Glass and Light
  • Read the lines yourself, load a voice file or use a Mac voice
  • A voiceover SRT lands each beat on its line
  • Revisions carry player errors back to Claude
  • Every version kept; projects export as .json
  • Records with your voice, then opens in Ether’s Cut

Ethers Prism

Don’t ask the AI for the thing. Ask it for an instrument to make the thing.

Describe a goal and Ethers Prism builds you an editor: dials with named ends, plus fixed requirements. Move the dials, sweep one across its range, branch through history, and render the version you choose with an authorship log. It runs on your Mac, with local models or your own Claude and ChatGPT accounts, and no API keys.

  • Eight fields, from Text and Image to Beats
  • 3D Stage, Animation and Line Logo in Blender
  • Agents on Claude, ChatGPT, LM Studio or Ollama
  • Teach by example from your starred results
  • Beats built from your own sample library
  • A Checker that flags problems and never rewrites

Ether’s Cymatic

Sound you can see as light.

Type a word and hear it as a tone, play a pure note, upload a song or sing into the mic, and watch the sound settle into glowing patterns. Each look is a small physics model: sand on a vibrating brass plate, ripples in a dish of water, and bubbles that glow as the sound crushes them.

  • Every word gets its own tone, or is spoken aloud
  • Pure tones from 20 to 2000 Hz, with 432 and 528 Hz picks
  • Sand, Water and Light, each a physics model
  • Songs and your microphone drive the pattern
  • Colour from the note, raised octave by octave into light
  • Saves stills and records video, up to 4K

LightBody Activation

Music lights the body, root to crown.

The screen stays dark until the music calls the first light. Each accent opens the next of seven centres; then light runs along the body’s fibres, the heart begins to beat, and a torsion field turns around the figure inside Flower of Life bubbles. Touch any point to hear its tone, follow the fourteen meridians with Five Element notes, or write a guided session as a script. It is artistic and symbolic, not medical.

  • Seven centres lit on musical accents
  • Fibre-optic light and a beating heart
  • Torsion field and Flower of Life bubbles
  • 14 meridians with Five Element tones
  • A tone sequencer and session scripts
  • Records video and stills, up to 4K

Ether Lumen

Build light-and-sound journeys for the mind.

Lay out a session as segments, each with its own length, a frequency that glides from start to end, and colours for the left and right eye. Watch the frequency line move through the Delta to Gamma bands, hear it as binaural beats or isochronic tones, and preview the light on screen. Glow mode never flickers; Pulse mode follows the session.

  • Segments with frequency ramps
  • Left and right eye colours
  • Binaural beats and isochronic tones
  • A frequency score over the brainwave bands
  • Glow and Pulse light preview
  • Four presets, undo and JSON sessions

About Ether

Ether is a state of mind, and the expression of whatever medium carries the art.

Ether makes AI art and music in many voices, writes books drawn from lived experience, and animates the characters of Zero’s Journey, where Ether travels with Element, a tiger who changes form with each world.

The apps here grew out of that work. They are the tools Ether wanted for making music videos, finding visual styles, sitting quietly with sound and light, exploring the sky, explaining ideas in 3D, hearing words read in a voice of one’s own, watching sound turn into light, spinning shapes beyond three dimensions, studying teachers and old texts closely, searching the public record and journeying inward.
